messages:
morgan: Ran a cross-region kernel sweep for the new q8 3B bring-up. Quick summary: FlashV3 lowest p50 on H100; Triton edges out for p95 throughput on A100; vendor lib (cuDNN) shows instability in SA region tails. Heatmap + raw logs attached: https://artifacts/redwood/bench/173820

priya: Nice, can you paste the command you used? want to reproduce the SA tail on our side. :eyes:

morgan: sure — command:```bash
./bench.py --model rwd-3b-q8 --kernels flashv3,triton,cudnn --gpus h100,a100 --regions us,eu,sa,ap --batch-sizes 1,8 --requests 2000
```

ben: pasted numbers (p50/p95/p99 ms) from the SA H100 run: flashv3 48/120/220, triton 60/140/260, cudnn 85/300/1200. APAC H100 similar but cudnn worse. US/EU tails are fine.

morgan: exact — cudnn has long tail in SA (p99 spikes at infra GC time). logs show CUDA memmgr retries around those spikes. snippet:```
[2025-06-29T10:13:02Z] WARN memmgr: retrying alloc after OOM fallback
[2025-06-29T10:13:02Z] INFO kernel(cudnn)::fallback_to_cpu
```

infra-bot: deploy-check: canary pool created in sa-west-1 with flashv3 enabled (id: canary-173820). 25% traffic routing ready.

ana: Proposal: keep FlashV3 as default for H100 in all regions, Triton as default for A100. Add a region-level override that prefers Triton or FlashV3 based on recent p95 window. For cudnn, mark as "best-effort" and only route if both primary kernels fail. Thoughts? :thinking_face:

priya: +1 for region override. Also suggest a hysteresis of 10 minutes and require 3 consecutive p95 breaches before switching to avoid flip-flop.

ben: Agree. Also add a metric to monitor "fallback_count(cudnn)" and alert at >2/min to catch those GC holes. We should stash the per-population heatmap under /ops/bench/ so SRE/Capacity can size pools.

morgan: I'll open a small RFC with the routing policy pseudo:```yaml
policy:
  default_by_gpu:
    h100: flashv3
    a100: triton
  region_overrides:
    sa-west-1:
      prefer: triton
      hysteresis: 600  # seconds
  vendor_fallbacks:
    cudnn: only-on-failure
```
I'll attach raw CSV and the heatmap images. Planning a canary roll tomorrow morning.

priya: ack — will try to reproduce cudnn tail locally and report with logs. If we see GC pattern we can add mem tuning as a mitigation. :thumbsup:

ben: FYI will add capacity cushion for SA H100 pool +10% before canary.

morgan: thanks team — filing followups and RFC link once created.
